Frequently Asked Questions About Mini Splits in McKinley, MN

A mini split heat pump provides both cooling and heating. In summer, it extracts heat from your home and moves it outside. In winter, it reverses the process, extracting heat from the outdoor air in McKinley, MN and bringing it inside.

We recommend mini split cleaning every 6â€“12 months in McKinley, MN. If you run your system heavily or have pets/allergies, quarterly cleanings are ideal. Regular cleaning improves efficiency, air quality, and extends system life by 3â€“5 years.
